description: Ecluses issues de VisuRIS en Wallonie (BE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. This INSPIRE data layer compiles information from the INSPIRE theme "hydrography" - locks. This data in INSPIRE compliant format comes from the VisuRIS Comex business data under Directive 2005/44/EC The European Directive 2007/2/EC - INSPIRE Directive - establishes an Infrastructure for Spatial Information in the European Community. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - Locks from VisuRIS in Wallonia (BE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Its keywords include Hydrographie, hydrography, bassin versant fluvial, directive relative à la qualité de l'eau, hydrologie, bassin versant. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
